input.content:
FROM node:22-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/
COPY public/ ./public/
CMD ["npm", "start"]

services:
  api-server:
    build: .
    command: npm start
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8080:8080"
    environment:
      PORT: "8080"
      DB_PATH: "/data/app.db"
      LIVE_UPDATE_SERVER_PUBLIC_URL: "ws://localhost:8081"
    volumes:
      - data:/data
  live-update-server:
    build: .
    command: npm run start:live-update-server
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8081:8081"
    environment:
      LIVE_UPDATE_SERVER_PORT: "8081"
      API_SERVER_URL: "ws://api-server:8080"
    depends_on:
      - api-server
volumes:
  data:

# Running auction locally

## Start

    docker compose up --build

Then open http://localhost:8080 in your browser.

## Services

| Service | Port | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| api-server | 8080 | HTTP API and web page, primary service |
| live-update-server | 8081 | WebSocket live updates for browsers |

The named volume `data` is mounted at /data in api-server. It holds the SQLite database (/data/app.db) with users, items and bids.

## Stop and reset

- Stop: `docker compose down`
- Reset the data: `docker compose down -v`

## Port 8080 taken

Change the published port in compose.yaml (the left side of "127.0.0.1:8080:8080", and keep PORT in step) and update the URL in this file. If you change 8081, also change LIVE_UPDATE_SERVER_PUBLIC_URL.
